title: One total, two repositories
summary: The shop page showed a total that was a hundred times too big. The fix is in two repositories: orders-api gives the total in cents with its currency, and storefront reads those cents. Both changes have to be merged together.

scenes.title: The mission

narration.text: The shop page showed totals a hundred times too big. Both repositories change to fix it.

scenes.visualDescription: Title card that names both repositories.

scenes.title: The wrong total

narration.text: Twelve euros fifty showed as one thousand two hundred fifty: cents shown as euros.

visual.problem: The basket page showed 1250.00 EUR for an order of 12.50 EUR.
visual.goal: Give the total a clear unit in the service, and read that unit in the page.

points.text: orders-api answers with totalCents and the currency
storefront reads totalCents and divides it by 100

scenes.visualDescription: The problem, the goal and the two changes.

narration.text: In orders-api, the answer now gives totalCents and the currency.

focus.note: the total in cents, and its currency

scenes.title: storefront reads cents

narration.text: In storefront, formatMoney now takes cents and divides them by one hundred.
The page passes it totalCents and the currency.

scenes.visualDescription: The changed price format of storefront.

scenes.title: How the two fit

narration.text: The page asks orders-api for an order.
The answer carries cents and the currency.
The page shows the right price.

nodes.label: storefront
nodes.detail: storefront: the shop page that shows the total

nodes.label: orders-api
nodes.detail: orders-api: the service that answers with the order

nodes.label: totalCents and currency
nodes.detail: orders-api: the new answer that storefront reads

scenes.visualDescription: The page, the service and the new answer between them.

scenes.title: What to check

narration.text: orders-api no longer exports orderTotal, so look for other callers.
formatMoney now takes cents, so check its callers too.

items.title: orderTotal is removed
items.detail: Nothing else in orders-api may call it.

items.title: formatMoney takes cents
items.detail: Other callers must give cents, not euros.

scenes.visualDescription: Two review points, one for each repository.

scenes.title: Wrap up

narration.text: Merge both pull requests together. Each alone shows a wrong total.

points.text: orders-api gives totalCents and the currency
storefront reads cents and shows a price
